decisions.states: fresh | stale | gone | not-indexed | absent — a boolean would destroy the last three
decisions.scope: a separate self-describing block; project-wide counts are untouched so the two cannot be merged
decisions.resolution: the same realpath-based primitive bb_edit uses, so the two tools agree on what a path IS
decisions.bounds: at most 50, validated at the boundary, because the whole point is O(files named)

limitations: The `absent` case is asserted with a path that does not exist. A caller who misspells an EXISTING file gets `not-indexed` rather than `absent`, because the two are genuinely indistinguishable from the filesystem alone; the reason string says which case it is.
